text_block_list.text: On the way back from running errands with Symboli Kris S—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good day! ...Could it be
that you're all joining in on this sale too?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Sale?
...Of this shopping district?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Apparently all the shops will be
selling off their unsold stock at huge discounts!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Leftovers...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...No, it's outside my mission parameters.
—I have no plans to participate.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ! ...Mm-hmm, I see~.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, all the more reason to join in!
Bargain sales are Japanese culture, after all!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
To bring excitement to the Japanese Umamusume world,
should we not experience as much Japanese culture as possible... perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—!
—...I suppose—that makes sense too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
...I leave the decision... to you.
Judging from how she acted earlier, she seems particularly interested in the fact that they're 'leftover clearance items,' but—
choice_data_list: A sale is a battlefield... Are you prepared for that?
A sale is a battlefield, you know... Are you ready for it?
Go ahead and try as many times as you like.
But impulse buying is dangerous, so...

text_block_list.text: Judging from how she acted earlier, she seems particularly interested in the fact that they're 'leftover clearance items,' but—
choice_data_list: A sale is a battlefield... Are you prepared for that?
A sale is a battlefield, you know... Are you ready for it?
Go ahead and try as many times as you like.
But impulse buying is dangerous, so...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. I am—fully prepared for it all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're full of spirit!
If you're looking for a battlefield... how about an all-you-can-stuff meat sale?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
How much meat can you stuff into the bag within the time limit...!
Doesn't that sound kind of thrilling?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"—Very well.
——Victory shall be mine."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's decided!
Let us be on our way~!

text_block_list.name: Butcher Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, it's all-you-can-pack diced steak~!
Time limit is one minute! Ready... gooo!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Swiftly—yet meticulously—!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho, heave-ho... Mmm,
a gap keeps opening up no matter what...!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Female Customer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you guys are doing it all wrong!
When it's all-you-can-stuff,
you have to stretch the bag to its limits first!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――! I see――the battle――
begins――before packing――!

With helpful advice from the shopkeeper,
the two struggle to bag everything up—

text_block_list.name: Butcher Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
—3, 2, 1, zero~!
Time's uuuup~~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That went by in a flash~!
Kris, how were your results?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —This is it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wah! There are so many!
Stacked neatly without any gaps... You're so dexterous!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I must... save...
even more of them...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—The results... are splendid.
With this... I can allow her to fulfill... her duty—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

Her eyes, fixed upon the bag bulging with raw meat,
seemed deeply satisfied—
and filled with profound benevolence.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: âStretching... the bag...
(BANG!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—!
I lost...

text_block_list.name: Butcher Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
—3, 2, 1, zero~!
Time's uuuup~~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what a shame.
Packing a lot in is surprisingly hard, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...The defeated... must simply depart.

Symboli Kris S gracefully departed the battlefield.
There was something lonely about her retreating figure...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Well then, I'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
So, where should we check out first? Any preferences?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —No... anywhere is fine.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Well then, how about that general store over there?
I think it's quite a hidden gem!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —! ...Yeah—I don't mind.
And so, the two of them set off for the bargain sale at the general store!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, are those the sale items?
There are so many fun-looking things!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that's awesome! A... globe figurine? How fun~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —It's gathered... a little dust. ...I think I'll buy it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, they even have ramen figurines over here!
Maybe I'll buy one♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What a haul~~! Look, look! Even though I bought
all this, it was super cheap!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah.
Pretty much all of—the less popular items.
choice_data_list: Think it could be useful for something?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Ah―― I shall find it.
Without fail―― these―― duties.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: So—there is no longer... any need to worry.
Saying so, Symboli Kris S gently cradled the plastic bag. Knowing her, she will surely treasure every single item she bought.
Three minutes after seeing Symboli Kris S and the others off—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――...It seems――I scared the other customers.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Because I am here... no one—can enter—the shop—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Oh, Kris, you're so sweet.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
They'll sell more goods if other customers can fit inside,
so we decided to wrap things up early and head out.
choice_data_list: I see... Were you able to buy anything?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Just one thing...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —The rest... I entrust... to the other customers.
Saying so, she looked back toward the variety store. She seemed a little lonely, but out of respect for her kindness, I decided to head home for today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: âImpulse buying...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Indeed.
Unplanned... actions are... risky.
"Even so... I'd really like to honor her feelings of wanting to help out with the unsold goods somehow."
choice_data_list: Allow me to at least cheer you on.

text_block_list.text:
Even if Symboli Kris S couldn't buy anything herself,
she could still watch over Fine Motion buying the surplus goods.
When I explained this to herâ

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—I... see.
Then—please let me—watch over you—from here.”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's really encouraging!
Just watch, I'm gonna buy a whole bunch of clearance items!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Yeah... please do.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wapu...! There are so many people...!
But still, I won't give up~...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Hang in there, Fine—!
The register is—right there—!

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
“—Seems pretty lively over there.
—Oh, look, a sale! Wanna check it out?”
Passersby noticed the sale, bringing in even more customers—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm back! Quite a big haul today!
I managed to buy a ton of bargain items♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Besides... there's an incredible line outside! At this rate, we'll sell out in no time!
choice_data_list: All that cheering really paid off.
All that cheering really paid off.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Ah――... thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer... It's all thanks to you.
Watching the sale items fly off the shelves one after another, Symboli Kris S's eyes softened with a gentle smile.
